title: Omukkiriza Omubikka mu Kkooti y’Omutyobooli
intro: Munda mu bisenge ebya zaabu eby’omufuzi asinga okwegulumiza amanyiddwa Quran — okujeemera Obwakatonda gye kwannyonnyolanga buli kiragiro — emmeeme emu yatambulanga mu bantu ab’enkizo, ng’ekweka ebyama ebisinga okuba eby’obulabe mu maaso. Omuntu ono ssekinnoomu yasitula enzikiriza eyagaaniddwa ennyo munda mu bbugwe oyo ne kiba nti okugizuula kwanditegeeza okufa okukakafu. Naye okukkiriza kwayaka ng’ennimi z’omuliro wansi w’evvu, era akaseera bwe kaatuuka, amazima ne gavuga n’obuvumu obwakankanya omusingi gwennyini ogw’olubiri lw’omutyobooli.
clues: Nnabeera mu kibiina eky’omunda eky’omufuzi asinga amaanyi era ow’amalala mu kiseera kyange, nga nneetooloddwa eby’okwejalabya ​​n’obuyinza.
Nnakweka enzikiriza yange entuufu munda mu mutima gwange, nga ntya obulamu bwange eri abo abaafuganga n’obukambwe n’okunyigirizibwa.
Abantu bange bwe baabuusabuusa era ne bawuubaala mu maaso g’amazima, nagenda mu maaso okubalabula ku nkomerero ey’ennaku eyali etuuse ku mawanga agayise agaana ababaka ba Mukama waabwe.
Najjukiza abantu bange emboozi y’omuvubuka omuloosi omwagalwa eyasuulibwa wansi ab’eŋŋanda ze naye n’asituka n’afuna obuyinza obw’amaanyi mu nsi ey’ewala.
Nakubiriza abantu bange obutagondera mufuzi eyababuzaabuza, mu kifo ky’ekyo ne mbayita okungoberera mu kkubo ery’obutuukirivu n’obulagirizi.
Nayogera amazima mu lwatu wadde ng’abagoberezi b’omutyobooli bantiisatiisa okunkuba amayinja oba okungoba mu nsi.
